 Judgment

Dated this the 07th day of March, 2025 This appeal is filed challenging the judgment dated 29.01.2015 in L.A.R.No.49 of 2012 on the files of the II Additional Subordinate Judge's Court,
Thiruvananthapuram.

II Additional Subordinate Judge's Court,
Thiruvananthapuram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Appellant was the claimant in the L.A.R. and the respondent was the respondent therein.
2. An extent of 0.60 Ares of land comprised in Sy.No.169/22 of Cheruvaickal Village in Thiruvananthapuram District belonging to the appellant was acquired for widening Ulloor-Akkulam-Kuzhivila road.
Section 4(1) notification was published on 12.12.2007.
Award was passed on 30.12.2010, fixing the land value at Rs.2,26,792/- per Are.
Land was taken possession on 12.01.2011.
Dissatisfied with the compensation awarded, the appellant filed an application under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act for enhanced compensation.
She contended that on the date of notification, the land acquired would have fetched a minimum of Rs.18,00,000/- per cent as land value.
The reference court, vide the impugned judgment fixed the land value at Rs.24,17,100/- per Are.

Contending that this Court had in L.A.A.No.162 of 2013 in respect of the same acquisition under the 2025:KER:33858 same notification fixed the land value at Rs.32,90,000/- per Are in respect of the property under the same category, the appellant has preferred this appeal.

3. Heard Sri.R.S.Kalkura, Advocate, for the appellant and Smt.Rekha C.Nair, learned Senior Government Pleader for the respondent.
4.

It is brought to my notice that this Court had in L.A.A.No.7 of 2016 rendered a judgment dated 18.01.2016 with respect to the very same acquisition and had fixed the land value at Rs.30,18,413/-
per Are.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is also entitled to the very same land value since the properties are situated in the very same village and had been acquired for the same purpose.
5. I have perused a copy of the judgment dated 18.01.2016 in L.A.A.No.7 of 2016.
I find that the appellant herein is also entitled to the very same land value as re-fixed by this Court in the said L.A.A.
Accordingly, this L.A.A. is disposed of holding that the appellant shall be entitled to a land value of Rs.30,18,413/- per Are commensurate to the land acquired from her.
She shall also be entitled to all statutory benefits in accordance with law.
However, 2025:KER:33858 she shall not be entitled to interest for the period of 1172 days which is the delay that had occasioned in filing the appeal.

Following the dictum as laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Amanullah Khan v.
State of Haryana and another [(2022) SCC OnLine SC 1184], the appellant/claimant will not be entitled to any statutory benefits on the enhanced amount of compensation either for the said period of delay.
